script_source:
import collections,hashlib,itertools,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/src')
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES,fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing
source=Path('/private/tmp/fq-synthesis-matrix-products-20261122/docs/development/evidence/commuting-frontier-screen.json');index=json.loads(source.read_text())
p={k:v for k,v in index.items() if k not in ('payload_files','original_observation_sha256','original_field_order')};p['payloads']={}
for item in index['payload_files']:
 data=(source.parent/item['path']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
 values=json.loads(data);assert len(values)==item['payload_count'];assert not set(values).intersection(p['payloads']);p['payloads'].update(values)
p={key:p[key] for key in index['original_field_order']}
reconstructed=(json.dumps(p,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()
assert hashlib.sha256(reconstructed).hexdigest()==index['original_observation_sha256'] and p['completed']
expected={(f'{w:02d}/{f}/{t}',flow,variant,11) for w,f,t,flow,variant in itertools.product(WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES,tuple(p['manifest']['configurations']),('baseline','candidate'))}
actual=collections.Counter((r['case'],r['workflow'],r['variant'],r['seed']) for r in p['rows']);assert set(actual)==expected and set(actual.values())=={1}
canonical=lambda x:json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
digest=lambda x:hashlib.sha256(canonical(x).encode()).hexdigest()
bundle=Bundle(Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/docs/implementation'));inputs={i['case']:i for i in p['inputs']};maximum=0;count=0
for row in p['rows']:
 width,family,topology=row['case'].split('/');width=int(width)
 f=fixture(width,family,topology,p['manifest']['input_nonce']);assert digest(f)==inputs[row['case']]['fixture_sha256']
 encoded=p['payloads'][row['payload_sha256']];assert hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode()).hexdigest()==row['payload_sha256']
 payload=json.loads(encoded);payload['compile_wall_seconds']=row['compile_wall_seconds']
 case=bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width==8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}'];metrics=routing(payload,f,None,case,0)
 assert row['status']=='accepted' and metrics==row['metrics'] and payload['final_layout']==list(range(width))
 maximum=max(maximum,metrics['max_semantic_error']);count+=1
 if count%40==0:print(json.dumps({'phase':'independent-archive-replay','accepted':count}),flush=True)
assert not {'flagquantum','qiskit','cirq'}.intersection(sys.modules)
proof={'scope':'Fresh independent replay of the complete frozen inspected-input archive','source_commit':p['source_commit'],'observation_sha256':index['original_observation_sha256'],'archive_index_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'payload_files':index['payload_files'],'exact_original_bytes_reconstructed':True,'expected_rows':len(expected),'replayed':count,'producer_sdks_imported':False,'maximum_semantic_error':maximum,'full_operator_rows':sum(r['metrics']['verification']=='full-operator' for r in p['rows']),'three_probe_rows':sum(r['metrics']['verification']=='three-probes-only' for r in p['rows']),'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'script_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
Path('/private/tmp/fq-commuting-frontier-replay-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in proof.items() if k!='script_source'}))
